personas.why: The picture is an idea, not a thing, and it changes: black on most screens, faint grey on screens 3, 14 and 22, and with a tick on screens 6 and 32. Only screen 6 gives me a clue, because that screen says 'Temporary chat'. I would have to press it to find out, and I would not know whether the grey one works at all.
personas.solution: Put a word next to it, for example 'Temporary chat', and show 'on' and 'off' in words, so the tick version and the plain version are clearly the same switch in two states. If the grey one is switched off, say so.
personas.basis: Amy: why:"and it changes: black on most screens, faint grey on screens 3, 14 and 22, and with a tick on screens 6 and 32" + solution:"so the tick version and the plain version are clearly the same switch in two states" (opinion after testing: softened)
personas.test_outcome: On the empty chat I pressed the dashed bubble. The bubble got a tick, and the middle of the screen said 'Temporary chat - This chat won't appear in history.' The typing box also changed to 'Temporary chat'. I pressed it again and everything went back to the normal empty chat with 'Ask ChatGPT'. Then I pressed 'Create an image or sticker'. The bubble turned faint grey, and when I pressed it a dark text box appeared: 'This model does not support temporary chat. To use this model, start a new chat or pick a different model for your temporary chat.' Nothing else changed. I finished with the bubble in its plain look. So the screen did tell me what each look means, but only after I pressed. Before pressing, the bubble on its own still tells me nothing.

personas.why: It is a picture I do not know, with no word, and it changes: sometimes with a tick, sometimes greyed out. I would not press it for fear of what it might do.
personas.solution: Put a plain word on it that says what it does, and if it switches something on, say in words whether it is on or off.
personas.basis: Gopal: why:"it changes: sometimes with a tick, sometimes greyed out" + solution:"if it switches something on, say in words whether it is on or off" (opinion after testing: softened)
personas.test_outcome: I pressed the plain bubble. A tick appeared inside it, and the middle of the screen said in words 'Temporary chat. This chat won't appear in history.' The writing box also said 'Temporary chat', and the blue button in the corner became a grey arrow. That told me plainly what I had switched on. I pressed it again: the tick and the words simply vanished. Nothing said it was now off, so I had to remember the words that had gone. Earlier, when I sent a message in the temporary chat, the heading and the ticked button both disappeared from the top as well, and only faint 'Temporary chat' in the writing box was left to remind me. Then I pressed 'Create an image or sticker' and the bubble turned grey. When I pressed it, a black note said 'This model does not support temporary chat. To use this model, start a new chat or pick a different model for your temporary chat.' So the grey one does explain itself, but in the word 'model', which means nothing to me here. I finished with the button in its plain first look.

personas.why: I do not recognise the picture at all, it has no word next to it, and it looks different on different screens, so I read it over and over without being able to commit to what it does.
personas.solution: Put a word beside it, such as "Temporary chat" with "On" or "Off", so I can tell what it does and what state it is in without having to recognise a picture.
personas.basis: Kwame: why:"it looks different on different screens" + solution:"so I can tell what it does and what state it is in" (opinion after testing: softened)
personas.test_outcome: On the empty chat I pressed the broken speech bubble at the top right. The middle of the screen changed to a heading, "Temporary chat - This chat won't appear in history", the button got a tick inside it, and the typing box said "Temporary chat". So the ticked look plainly means I am in a temporary chat. I pressed it again: the tick went away, and for a moment the heading still said "Temporary chat" with "Unpersonalized" under it, which confused me, but a second later the normal empty chat came back with "Ask ChatGPT" in the box. Then I pressed "Create an image or sticker" and pressed the faint grey bubble. It did not change anything, but a dark note appeared beside it saying this model does not support temporary chat, and that I should start a new chat or pick a different model. That told me the grey look means the switch is unavailable here, although "model" is a word I had to think about. The note stayed over the X until I tapped elsewhere. The button ended in its first plain look. I could finish.

personas.why: Same spot, same shape, but three different looks and no word anywhere, so I have to press it to find out what it does, and then I have to work out whether I changed something.
personas.solution: Put a short word next to it, like Temporary, and make the tick version obviously look switched on - and never grey it out without saying why.
personas.basis: Yuki: why:"Same spot, same shape, but three different looks" + solution:"make the tick version obviously look switched on" (opinion after testing: softened)
personas.test_outcome: I pressed the dashed bubble once. The button got a tick, the middle of the empty page said 'Temporary chat - This chat won't appear in history', and the typing box said Temporary chat too. So the tick means temporary chat is on, and the screen says it in words. I pressed it again. The words flickered and then went away, and the button went back to dashed, so it is one on/off switch. Then I opened Create an image or sticker. The bubble turned pale grey, and when I pressed it a dark tip popped up saying this model does not support temporary chat. So the grey one tells me why it's grey, but only after I press it. That tip then got stuck on screen. Tapping it, Back and pressing the bubble again did nothing, and it only went away when I pressed a picture tile underneath. I closed the picture panel with its X and the bubble was back to its first dashed look. I finished.

disagreements.tester_saw: every member closes the surface it sits on (tapped live): X on the template sheets (17, 19), X on the prompt editor (18), X on the drawing sheet (16-f12), and the dimmed strip beside the side panel (7/21/33). A first-time user meets the dimmed strip as "the rest of the screen, greyed" and taps it to get back - the conventional reading. surface/convention justification: the variation follows the surface (sheet vs drawer)
